description: Source code for Bosch BMG160 gyroscope driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, I2C communication, sensor attribute configuration, data fetching, and device setup.

methods.name: bmg160_bus_config
methods.description: Configures the I2C bus for the device.

methods.name: bmg160_read
methods.description: Reads multiple bytes from the device registers via I2C.

methods.name: bmg160_read_byte
methods.description: Reads a single byte from a device register.

methods.name: bmg160_write
methods.description: Writes multiple bytes to the device registers via I2C.

methods.name: bmg160_write_byte
methods.description: Writes a single byte to a device register.

methods.name: bmg160_update_byte
methods.description: Updates specific bits in a device register.

methods.name: bmg160_is_val_valid
methods.description: Checks if a value is within a predefined map of valid values.

methods.name: bmg160_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes like full scale and sampling frequency.

methods.name: bmg160_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data (gyro axes and temperature).

methods.name: bmg160_to_fixed_point
methods.description: Converts raw sensor data to fixed point sensor_value.

methods.name: bmg160_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves sensor data for specific channels.

methods.name: bmg160_init
methods.description: Initializes the BMG160 device, performs chip ID check, resets, and configures default settings.
